title: Inference Plan
description: Budget and risk aware execution plan: model class, reasoning budget, tools, context and verification profiles, ordered fallbacks and escalation policy. Provider name is adapter-owned and optional; routing stays deterministic by default. Minimal example: {"schema_version": "inference-plan/0.1", "model_class": "local_small", "reasoning_budget": "low", "context_profile": "compiled", "verification_profile": "standard", "escalation_policy": {"max_retries": 2, "max_restorations": 4, "escalate_to": "human"}}. Transcribed from docs/msi/05-msi-spec-v0.md section 3.

schema_version.description: Schema identifier and version. Must equal inference-plan/0.1.

model_class.description: Model tier: local_tiny, local_small, fast_hosted or frontier. Adapter resolves the concrete model.

provider.description: Optional adapter-owned provider label. Core routing never depends on it.

reasoning_budget.description: Reasoning effort budget: none, low, medium or high.

context_profile.description: Context shape: full, compiled or minimal.

verification_profile.description: Verification strictness: strict, standard or light.

fallbacks.description: Ordered fallback steps evaluated after a failure.

trigger.description: Condition that fires this fallback: VERIFY_FAIL, TIMEOUT or LOW_CONF.

escalate_to.description: Escalation target: human, frontier tier or abort.
